record.question: 2020 Summer Olympics will begin in:
record.explanation: Answer A: July 2020. At the time of this June 2019 paper, the Tokyo 2020 Olympics were scheduled to start in July 2020; they were later postponed because of COVID-19. Reference: https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/tokyo-2020. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
